name: Jean-Paul Marat
role: French revolutionary journalist; deputy to the National Convention (1792-93)
summary: Journalist of L'Ami du peuple and Convention deputy who demanded harsh action against the revolution's enemies, including a military tribune or dictator. His own newspaper texts and letters settle only a few of the statements; most modern ones are null.
